title: ABC Statement on Race Around the World film - About the ABC
text:
The ABC refers to the film in a recent episode of Race Around the World referencing Mrs Gina Rinehart AO.

While the Ombudsman has found that the film did not breach the ABC's editorial policies, the ABC acknowledges the episode has fallen short of community expectations.

The ABC apologises to Mrs Rinehart and to anyone else affected or upset by the publication of the film.

As part of our review of this matter, we have considered whether the guidance in the ABC Editorial Policies adequately reflects current community expectations.

We have also considered whether the relevant guidance sufficiently distinguishes between news and non-news content.

As a result, the ABC will amend its guidance as it applies to violence.

The film has been edited on the ABC's platforms to remove the relevant material.

Hugh Marks

Managing Director
